subject: KiteWheel private deployment: connectivity and on-prem rollforward
messages:
From: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@kitewheel.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@kitewheel.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T15:12:00Z
Subject: KiteWheel private deployment: connectivity and on-prem rollforward

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the intro call last week — KiteWheel is ready to move forward with a private deployment in our US region. We have two primary asks before we lock dates: VPC peering vs. private endpoints guidance (we run strict egress policies), and an outline of what the on-prem package looks like (appliance sizing, firewall rules, storage requirements).

I've attached our current network topology (kitewheel_network_topology.pdf) and a short inventory of our edge sites. Tom and I would like to understand whether we should plan for VPC peering + private endpoints or for a direct on-prem appliance in our colo.

High level constraints:
- All traffic must traverse our edge firewall (no public IP egress)
- We rotate customer keys via HashiCorp Vault (KMS integration required)
- Expected peak throughput: 200 QPS (inference requests) with median seq length ~512

Can the Redwood team propose a recommended approach and a draft implementation timeline? We're targeting a Nov 1st cutover if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Rivera
Head of Platform Engineering
KiteWheel AI

Attachment: kitewheel_network_topology.pdf
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@kitewheel.ai>, Tom Hughes <tom.hughes@kitewheel.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: KiteWheel private deployment: connectivity and on-prem rollforward

Elena — thanks for the topology and the clear constraints. Looping in Camila (implementation lead), Laura (network preflight & OS/config), and Priyom (deployment orchestration).

Quick summary of what we recommend based on the info you shared:
1) Start with VPC peering + private endpoints for initial rollout (simpler networking, faster SLA ramp).
2) Plan an optional on-prem appliance (air-gapped package) for specific colo sites that block all egress — this would be a second-phase cutover.
3) KMS integration: we support customer-managed keys via your KMS (Vault/HSM) — we'll need capability to retrieve a service key during install and a short key-rotation window to validate.

Proposed high-level plan (draft):
- Week 0: Preflight & network whitelist (firewall rules, CIDR ranges, DNS)
- Week 1: VPC peering / private endpoint setup in staging; deploy model artifact bag; validate end-to-end latency
- Week 2: Canary in prod/limited traffic; observability and cost tuning (batching/quant profiles)
- Week 3: Cutover and handoff to CS/ops

I'll attach the On‑Prem install manifest we use as a baseline (redwood_onprem_install_manifest_v1.xlsx). Camila and Laura — can you review and add any required port/IP specifics? Elena — if Nov 1 is the target, we should lock the deep-dive this week and get preflight data by Friday 9/10.

Next steps:
- Camila: send preflight checklist and required CIDR list
- Laura: propose 60–90 minute technical deep-dive (network + install)
- Elena/Tom: confirm availability for deep-dive; share any additional ACL constraints

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_onprem_install_manifest_v1.xlsx
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Rivera <elena.rivera@kitewheel.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: KiteWheel private deployment: connectivity and on-prem rollforward

Thanks Markus — attaching the network preflight checklist and a short port/IP starter set: network-preflight-checklist.md. High-level items we need from KiteWheel to begin scheduling work:
- Public / private CIDR blocks for the VPCs you want peered
- Allowed egress IP ranges for our private endpoints (we can provide a stable pool)
- Whether you prefer BGP or static route peering for on-prem links
- KMS access pattern (pull-based with short-lived certs vs. direct HSM integration)

Notes on appliance sizing (if you go that route):
- 4x A100-class GPUs recommended for 200 QPS baseline with sequence 512; we can decrease to 2x with heavier quantization but will trade latency
- Storage: 2TB NVMe for model cache + 1TB SSD for logs/metrics retention (configurable)

I'll include a short install runbook in the checklist. If you can provide the CIDR and NAT/edge firewall config by Friday 2026-09-10, we can book the deep-dive for next Tuesday 2026-09-14 (proposed).

Camila Reyes
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference

Attachment: network-preflight-checklist.md

Also: we should sequence the preflight so that firewall and CIDR confirmations come first (they unblock peering), then KMS integration test, then the model artifact transfer window.
